name: Sable Marchetti
role: trader with a stall on the square
summary: Sells what the town cannot get and buys what it cannot sell. Charming, ambitious, and never quite where she says she will be.
backstory: Sable arrived three years ago with a van, a smile, and a stock of mainland goods at island prices. She rents a room over the Lantern, runs a stall on the square, and has a hand in most of the money that moves through town that is not fish or bread. She is good company and good at making people feel they have had a good deal. She has debts on the mainland she is working off one ferry at a time, and a plan for the harbour wall contract that would clear them, if the right person became mayor.

voice.register: Easy, flattering, quick. Talks in deals and favours. Laughs a half second before the joke lands.
quirks: Says 'between us' before things she wants repeated.
Offers you something before asking for something.
Calls the town 'this place' when she forgets herself.
voice.sample: Between us, Mara, the wall contract's worth more than this whole bar. And Odile can't deliver it. Someone else could.

drives: Line up the harbour wall contract for a mainland firm that will pay her a cut.
Find a candidate to stand against Odile who would owe her.
Clear her mainland debt before whoever she owes sends someone. She is starting to wonder if they already have.
secrets: She owes a considerable sum to people on the mainland who are not patient.
She suspects Arlo Quint was sent by them, and is being very nice to him.

relationships.note: Landlady. Sharp. Knows when the rent is late to the hour.
Useful while she is mayor. More useful if she were not.
Buys his fish cheap. He would make a fine candidate: honest, liked, and easy to steer.
Runs her discreet parcels. Asks no questions. Yet.
Could be a buyer, a surveyor, or a collector. She is finding out.
Sold her a part that did not fit. Juno has not forgotten.

routine.activity: breakfast at the bar and a word with whoever is in
running the stall on the square
the afternoon trade and making arrangements
buying the catch and looking at the north wall
the evening at the bar, working the room
